title: The world of Snowmoon: a proposed layout
label: AI-made: a proposed layout by an AI model, Claude (the coding agent, a closed model), from the world guide's geography lines; every placement is marked "book" or "placed by us". Not by the author.
license: A map proposal for Snowmoon by Vitalik Buterin, made from the book on 2026-10-11. GPL-3.0, like the book.
units: Degrees of latitude and longitude on an Earth-sized globe (our assumption). Places in the "northshore" frame are in the pixels of the book's battle map (c29-b34); places in the "uc" frame are in km east and north of Redshire. "book": the book fixes where it is relative to what is already placed; "placed by us": it does not.

views.title: The world of Snowmoon: a proposed layout
Northshore and Thaldur, on the book's battle map
The United Cities: the book's links, our positions

northshore.note: The book's own battle map, taken as north-up. Its scale is ours: 2.6 km per pixel makes Group North's route about 225 km, the "hundreds of kilometers" of cable (c29-b38). Anchored on Northglade.

uc.note: Anchored on Redshire. Where the United Cities are relative to Veridia, the book does not say.

places.name: Veridia
places.note: [region] The outline is ours: the book gives no coastline or border for Veridia except in Northshore.

places.name: Meldan
places.note: The capital. Where Veridia lies on the globe is ours; everything else in Veridia is placed relative to Meldan.

places.name: railway to Eldil
places.note: Trains run to Eldil (c29-b13); the route is ours.

places.name: Eldil
places.note: Where the army arrives by train (c29-b13). Not otherwise located.

places.name: Elenar Forest
places.note: [land] West of Northshore, where the groups start (c29-b13, c29-b34). Outline ours.

places.name: Hydrafill's northern ice
places.note: Thirty kilometers from the Arctic border, says an advertisement (c11-b124); where along the border is ours.

places.name: northern sea and inlet
places.note: [sea] The pale area at the top of the battle map (c29-b34). We read the pale areas as sea: Group Naval's seaborne drones start in one.

places.name: southern sea
places.note: [sea] The pale area at the lower right of the battle map (c29-b34).

places.name: Northshore
places.note: [land] The land between the two seas, east of the inlet: Group North reaching the inlet "cuts the Arctics off from the whole peninsula" (c29-b23). Coasts from the battle map; the western boundary, against Elenar Forest, is ours.

places.name: the eastern peninsula
places.note: [land] Dangling off the eastern end of Northshore, between Northglade and Thaldur (c31-b61). It leaves the battle map at its right edge between the two seas; the part beyond the edge is ours.

places.name: Northglade
places.note: On the battle map (c29-b34), at the southern sea. About 1,000 km north-east of Meldan (c17-b100, c23-b86) and over 200 km from the Arctic border (c17-b101).

places.name: Northglade's island
places.note: [land] About twenty kilometers wide, too small for simplified maps (c31-b4), which is why the battle map does not draw it. We put it at the coast where the battle map has Northglade.

places.name: the island's summit
places.note: Northglade's main city lies to its east (c31-b5).

places.name: border river
places.note: [water] The line between Veridian and core Arctic territory, reached by Group North (c30-b73). We run it west from the head of the inlet.

places.name: Arctic core (west of the inlet)
places.note: [region] Across the river from Veridia (c30-b73).

places.name: Group North
places.note: The battle map's dashed route (c29-b34).

places.name: Group Center
places.note: The battle map draws it heading east-north-east; the text says "directly east" (c29-b25).

places.name: Group South
places.note: The battle map draws it heading north-east, then east; the text says "toward the southeast" (c29-b27).

places.name: Thaldur
places.note: [region] An island east of Northshore, core Arctic territory (c30-b74), beyond the eastern peninsula (c31-b61). Size and distance ours.

places.name: Telten
places.note: Arctic core territory hundreds of kilometers east of Northglade, reached by sea (c29-b104). The book does not say whether it is on Thaldur or the Arctic mainland; we put it on Thaldur's west coast.

places.name: Arctic Empire
places.note: [region] North of Veridia and of the United Cities. The outline is ours; the book fixes only that it lies north of Northshore and of Redshire.

places.name: Glasscrown
places.note: A month and a half of polar night (c31-b44) puts it far north; where exactly is ours.

places.name: United Cities
places.note: [region] The coastline is ours; the book says only that the continent has many mountains and peninsulas (c10-b143).

places.name: gulf between Redshire and Arturia
places.note: [sea] The seaborne drone heads west from Redshire's coast to Arturia's (c26-b149, c26-b151). The gulf's shape is ours.

places.name: Redshire's south islands
places.note: Redshire has islands in the south (c4-b73). We put them in the gulf.

places.name: Redshire
places.note: Where the United Cities sit on the globe is ours. Nothing in the United Cities lies due north of Redshire (c10-b149, c13-b11).

places.name: Arturia
places.note: West of Redshire across water (c26-b149, c26-b151). We put it north-west, which keeps the co-governance links from crossing.

places.name: Petersvil
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Dzego
places.note: [region] Halfway across the world from Veridia, says Seila (c21-b85). Where exactly, and whether it shares the United Cities' continent (c22-b46), is ours to choose.

places.note: A train ride from Pafogai Du (c15-b119); no distance or time is given.
